home.title: Jacob Miller - Senior Software Engineer
home.description: Senior software engineer building in Angular and FastAPI. A hotel operations demo where every number on screen is read from a real database row.

dashboard.title: Real-Time Dashboard - Jacob Miller
dashboard.description: A live hotel operations dashboard. It reads a real API and degrades from WebSocket to polling to a committed fixture — telling you on screen which one you are looking at.

booking.title: Room Booking Engine - Jacob Miller
booking.description: A reactive form writing to the same database the dashboard reads. Submit a booking and the occupancy figures move. Server-side validation renders on the field that caused it.

work.title: Case Studies - Jacob Miller
work.description: Three decisions from work I cannot show you the code for. The code is the part under NDA; the reasoning is not, and the reasoning is the part worth reading.

writing.title: Writing - Jacob Miller
writing.description: MURMURATION_LOG: a dated, running log of work on MURMURATION, kept as it happens and published before it becomes an essay.

gallery.title: The Gallery - Jacob Miller
gallery.description: Choose a colour and a painting is hung for it: twenty-four public-domain works in seven colour groups, each with where to see it, how it was made and three ways of looking at it.

aesthetic.title: The Aesthetic Generator - Jacob Miller
aesthetic.description: Choose one colour from a wheel of 480, computed in OKLCH, and the other two of an aesthetic are chosen for it by published research on colour harmony, with its reasoning shown.

aubade.title: Hôtel Aubade - Floor 0, The Desk
aubade.description: A hotel lobby raymarched in a fragment shader. No 3D library, no meshes, no geometry — an interior that exists only as mathematics, lit by one shaft of moonlight through a transom.

aubadeReader.title: Hôtel Aubade - The Reader's Edition
aubadeReader.description: The hotel written out: six floors, the poem it is named after, and how a time zone and the equation of time decide whether it is open. No canvas, no WebGL, about twelve hundred words.

murmuration.title: murmuration - Jacob Miller
murmuration.description: a generator that models a biological murmuration patten by creating bird droids or boids
